test_set.english: Our code-review bot scores patches with the same model that wrote them, so an approval only certifies agreement-with-self, not quality.
The load-test harness calibrates its baselines from the service under load, so a pass only certifies agreement-with-self, not capacity.
That schema validator derives its expected shapes from the generator it checks, so a pass only certifies agreement-with-self, not correctness.
The backup verifier restores with the same tool that wrote the archive, so a success only certifies agreement-with-self, not recoverability.
Our lint gate trains its allow-list on the codebase it lints, so a clean run only certifies agreement-with-self, not safety.
The benchmark suite tunes its reference timings on the machine under test, so a win only certifies agreement-with-self, not speed.
That migration checker replays transactions through the migrator itself, so a match only certifies agreement-with-self, not fidelity.
The config auditor loads its policy from the deployment it audits, so compliance only certifies agreement-with-self, not correctness.
Our smoke suite asserts outputs produced by the build it smokes, so green only certifies agreement-with-self, not health.
The license scanner matches headers against its own template library, so a clear report only certifies agreement-with-self, not coverage.
That chaos probe reads steadiness from the orchestrator it disturbs, so calm only certifies agreement-with-self, not resilience.
The quota monitor forecasts usage with the scheduler it monitors, so headroom only certifies agreement-with-self, not availability.
Our secret scanner seeds its patterns from the vault it scans, so silence only certifies agreement-with-self, not secrecy.
The accessibility audit scores contrast with the renderer under review, so a pass only certifies agreement-with-self, not legibility.
That dependency bot vouches for pins using the resolver it wraps, so approval only certifies agreement-with-self, not integrity.
The alert triager ranks severity with the classifier under evaluation, so order only certifies agreement-with-self, not priority.
